name: Sapphira
summary: The wife of Ananias in the early church. She agreed with her husband to keep back part of the price of their land, lied to Peter about it, and fell down dead.

key_moments.title: Keeps Back Part of the Price
key_moments.description: Sapphira and her husband Ananias sold a piece of property. With her knowledge he kept back part of the money and laid only part of it at the apostles' feet.

key_moments.title: Lies to Peter About the Price
key_moments.description: About three hours after her husband died, Sapphira came in, not knowing what had happened. Peter asked if they had sold the land for that amount, and she said yes.

key_moments.title: Falls Dead at Peter's Feet
key_moments.description: Peter asked why they had agreed to tempt the Spirit of the Lord, and said the men who buried her husband were at the door to carry her out. She fell down at once and died, and they buried her beside her husband.
